headline: Taboola Partners with Smartphone Manufacturer to Integrate Generative AI
summary: Taboola plans to integrate its generative AI response engine into the lock screen of Moto G smartphones starting in late 2026.
why: Strategic hardware partnerships expand digital advertising reach and user engagement for ad-tech companies seeking new distribution channels.
